title: Club Equipment Defaults Schema
description: data/club-equipment.json: the TEAM-MERGED, per-club default overlay (club-equipment-reporting AC10/D12). For each club id, the catalog equipment ids the team has confirmed absent (and optionally present) after reviewing anonymous reports. Team-authored, never auto-generated from raw reports. Ships EMPTY in v1. The app seeds a user's local overlay from a club's entry the first time that club has no local record (AC12); a local record is always authoritative afterwards. Every object is closed (additionalProperties:false) so no free text can hide in the file. Referential integrity (ids against data/equipment.json, club ids against data/gyms/) is not expressible in JSON Schema and is enforced by scripts/validate-data.js validateClubEquipment. Confirmed-PRESENT club ids are ALSO recorded in equipment.json's existing verifiedAt array (AC13).

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only when the shape of this file changes.

absent.description: Catalog equipment ids the team confirmed this club does NOT have. Seeds the club's local exclusion list on first selection.

present.description: Catalog equipment ids the team confirmed this club DOES have. An id may not appear in both lists.
